Class BondTrade

java.lang.Object
com.dbtraining.reconx.model.BondTrade
All Implemented Interfaces:
TradeType, Comparable<TradeType>
public final class BondTrade extends Object implements TradeType
============================================================================ TICKET-ADV021 — BondTrade with Builder pattern WHAT: Fixed-income trade — couponRate, maturityDate, faceValue, isin. HOW: Same builder pattern. notional() = faceValue (in the bond's ccy). WHY: Bonds need couponRate/maturity for downstream cashflow modelling. Modelling them on the trade is the simplest path for the demo. ============================================================================ Equality and hashing are derived from tradeRef alone; toString omits counterparty identity to avoid leaking PII into logs.
